arguments.code:
import re, datetime
venmo_password = apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords()
venmo_pass = [x['password'] for x in venmo_password if x['account_name']=='venmo'][0]
venmo_username = 'ta.weav@gmail.com'
print('Using venmo_username:', venmo_username)
login = apis.venmo.login(username=venmo_username, password=venmo_pass)
print('login response:', login)
venmo_token = login.get('access_token')
print('token exists:', bool(venmo_token))

# fetch all sent payment requests
all_reqs=[]
page_limit=20
page_index=0
while True:
    page = apis.venmo.show_sent_payment_requests(access_token=venmo_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    print('page_index', page_index, 'count', len(page) if isinstance(page,list) else page)
    if not page:
        break
    all_reqs.extend(page)
    page_index += 1
print('total sent payment requests:', len(all_reqs))
# filter to those where receiver name/email contains Robert (case-insensitive)
pattern = re.compile('robert', re.I)
rob_reqs=[]
for r in all_reqs:
    recv = r.get('receiver',{})
    name = recv.get('name','') or ''
    email = recv.get('email','') or ''
    if pattern.search(name) or pattern.search(email):
        rob_reqs.append(r)
print('sent requests mentioning Robert:', len(rob_reqs))
# further filter approved
approved = [r for r in rob_reqs if r.get('approved_at')]
print('approved matching Robert:', len(approved))
# sort by created_at desc (parse)
def parse_dt(s):
    if not s: return None
    try:
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s.replace('Z','+00:00'))
    except Exception:
        return None
approved_sorted=sorted(approved, key=lambda r: parse_dt(r.get('created_at')) or parse_dt(r.get('approved_at')) or datetime.datetime.min, reverse=True)
print('top 5 approved matching Robert by created_at:')
for r in approved_sorted[:5]:
    recv = r.get('receiver',{})
    print(r.get('payment_request_id'), 'amount', r.get('amount'), 'receiver', recv.get('name'), recv.get('email'), 'created_at', r.get('created_at'), 'approved_at', r.get('approved_at'))

# select last request: first in sorted
selected = approved_sorted[0] if approved_sorted else None
print('selected payment_request:', None if not selected else (selected.get('payment_request_id'), selected.get('amount'), selected.get('receiver',{})))
